===== renderOsoShop =====
function renderOsoShop(){
 const shop=$('#osoShop');if(!shop)return;
 const skin=currentSkin(),preview=$('#selectedOsoPreview'),name=$('#selectedOsoName'),coin=$('#shopCoin');
 if(preview)preview.src=skin.src;if(name)name.textContent=skin.name;if(coin)coin.textContent=state.coins||0;
 const groups=[
  {id:'oso',title:'🐂 오소',sub:'중앙시장의 주인공 · 기본~750 코인'},
  {id:'ayo',title:'🐱 아요 컬렉션',sub:'표정과 동작이 다양한 친구 · 1,000~1,900 코인'},
  {id:'hamo',title:'🦦 하모 컬렉션',sub:'특별한 친구 · 2,000~2,900 코인'}
 ];
 shop.innerHTML=groups.map(gr=>{
  const cards=OSO_SKINS.filter(s=>(s.group||'oso')===gr.id).map(s=>{
   const owned=state.ownedSkins.includes(s.id),selected=state.selectedSkin===s.id;
   return `<div class="skinCard ${selected?'selected':''} group-${gr.id}" data-skin="${s.id}"><span class="charBadge ${gr.id}">${s.badge||gr.title}</span><img src="${s.src}" alt="${s.name}"><b>${s.name}</b><small>${s.note}</small><button class="${selected?'selectedBtn':owned?'owned':''}" data-buy="${s.id}">${selected?'사용 중':owned?'사용하기':`🪙 ${s.price.toLocaleString()} 구입`}</button></div>`
  }).join('');
  return `<div class="shopGroupHead ${gr.id}"><b>${gr.title}</b><small>${gr.sub}</small></div>${cards}`
 }).join('');
 $$('[data-buy]').forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{
   const s=OSO_SKINS.find(x=>x.id===btn.dataset.buy);if(!s)return;
   if(state.ownedSkins.includes(s.id)){state.selectedSkin=s.id;save();refresh();tone('good');return}
   if((state.coins||0)<s.price){tone('bad');buzz(70);btn.textContent='코인이 부족하소!';setTimeout(renderOsoShop,700);return}
   state.coins-=s.price;state.ownedSkins.push(s.id);state.selectedSkin=s.id;save();tone('clear');buzz([20,15,35]);refresh();try{if(window.__JCM_SP1_SYNC_UNLOCK__)window.__JCM_SP1_SYNC_UNLOCK__()}catch(_){}
 })
}

  tone('coin');buzz([12,6,22]);log(`${e.name}이(가) 동전을 떨어뜨렸다! 🪙 +${coinBonus}`);updateHud();return coinBonus
 }

 const BASE_MAX_LEVEL=20,LIMIT_BREAK_LEVEL=30,TP_ABSOLUTE_MAX=450;

 function hasLegendaryItem(){return !!(run.shield&&run.radish)}
 function currentLevelCap(){return hasLegendaryItem()?LIMIT_BREAK_LEVEL:BASE_MAX_LEVEL}
 function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v))}
 function tpCapForLevel(lv){
  const L=clamp(Math.floor(Number(lv)||1),1,currentLevelCap());
  if(L>=currentLevelCap())return TP_ABSOLUTE_MAX;
  return Math.min(TP_ABSOLUTE_MAX,100+Math.round((L-1)*(350/19)))
 }
 function expectedHeroCoreStats(lv){
  const L=clamp(Math.floor(Number(lv)||1),1,currentLevelCap());
  let hp=20,mp=6,atk=6,def=2;
  for(let n=2;n<=L;n++){
   const late=n>=15;
   hp+=late?8:6;mp+=late?3:2;atk+=late?3:2;def+=late?2:1
  }
  return {hp:Math.min(HERO_LIMITS.hp,hp),mp:Math.min(HERO_LIMITS.mp,mp),atk:Math.min(HERO_LIMITS.atk,atk),def:Math.min(HERO_LIMITS.def,def)}
 }
 function normalizeHeroProgress(){
  hero.lv=clamp(Math.floor(Number(hero.lv)||1),1,currentLevelCap());
  const coreFloor=expectedHeroCoreStats(hero.lv);
  const expectedTp=tpCapForLevel(hero.lv);
  hero.maxTp=clamp(Math.max(Number(hero.maxTp)||100,expectedTp),100,TP_ABSOLUTE_MAX);
  hero.tp=clamp(Number(hero.tp)||0,0,hero.maxTp);
  hero.maxHp=clamp(Math.max(Number(hero.maxHp)||20,coreFloor.hp),1,HERO_LIMITS.hp);
  hero.maxMp=clamp(Math.max(Number(hero.maxMp)||6,coreFloor.mp),0,HERO_LIMITS.mp);
  hero.atk=clamp(Math.max(Number(hero.atk)||6,coreFloor.atk),1,HERO_LIMITS.atk);
  hero.def=clamp(Math.max(Number(hero.def)||2,coreFloor.def),0,HERO_LIMITS.def);
  hero.hp=clamp(Number(hero.hp)||hero.maxHp,0,hero.maxHp);
  hero.mp=clamp(Number(hero.mp)||hero.maxMp,0,hero.maxMp);
  if(hero.lv>=currentLevelCap()){hero.lv=currentLevelCap();hero.xp=0;hero.next=0}
  else if(!Number(hero.next)||hero.next<=0)hero.next=8+hero.lv*5
 }

 function drawFullMap(){
  const m=map(),cols=m.grid[0].length,rows=m.grid.length;
  const cssW=Math.min(332,Math.max(260,window.innerWidth-54)),cssH=Math.round(cssW*rows/cols);
  const dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
  mapCanvas.width=Math.floor(cssW*dpr);mapCanvas.height=Math.floor(cssH*dpr);
  mapCanvas.style.height=cssH+'px';mapCtx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  const tw=cssW/cols,th=cssH/rows;
  mapCtx.fillStyle='#101820';mapCtx.fillRect(0,0,cssW,cssH);
  for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){
   mapCtx.fillStyle=fullMapColor(m.grid[y][x],m.theme);mapCtx.fillRect(x*tw,y*th,tw+.6,th+.6)
  }
  function dot(x,y,color,r=3){
   mapCtx.fillStyle='#0008';mapCtx.beginPath();mapCtx.arc((x+.5)*tw+1,(y+.5)*th+1,r+1.5,0,6.28);mapCtx.fill();
   mapCtx.fillStyle=color;mapCtx.beginPath();mapCtx.arc((x+.5)*tw,(y+.5)*th,r,0,6.28);mapCtx.fill()
  }
  for(const n of m.npcs)dot(n.x,n.y,n.role==='inn'?'#7dffc1':'#ffe161',3);
  if(m.warp)dot(m.warp.x,m.warp.y,m.warp.town?'#54e7ff':'#c26cff',4);
  for(const c of m.chests)if(!run.opened[c.id]&&!(c.hiddenUntil==='legend'&&!run.legendUnlocked))dot(c.x,c.y,'#ff9f35',3.2);
  if(m.boss&&!run.bossDefeated[zone])dot(m.boss.x,m.boss.y,'#c970ff',4);
  if(m.door)dot(m.door.x,m.door.y,'#64c9ff',3.6);
  if(zone===0)for(const e of SECRET_ENTRANCES)if(secretEntranceVisible(e))dot(e.x,e.y,e.kind=

 function offerPharmacy(npc){
  merchantTalk(npc,[{label:'💊 약 살펴보기',action:openPharmacy}],'구매 버튼을 누르기 전까지 코인은 차감되지 않습니다.')
 }
 function offerInn(npc){
  const can=(state.coins||0)>=RPG_INN_PRICE;
  merchantTalk(npc,[{label:`🛏️ 묵는다 · 🪙 ${RPG_INN_PRICE}`,disabled:!can,action:useInn}],can?'숙박을 선택해야만 코인이 차감됩니다.':'현재 코인이 부족합니다. 숙박은 실행되지 않습니다.')
 }
 function useInn(){
  if((state.coins||0)<RPG_INN_PRICE){showDialog(`여관 주인: 숙박비는 🪙 ${RPG_INN_PRICE}코인입니다.<br><b>코인이 부족합니다.</b>`);return}
  if(!spendCoins(RPG_INN_PRICE))return;

 }

 function levelUpCore(){
  const learned=[];
  normalizeHeroProgress();
  if(hero.lv>=currentLevelCap())return null;

  const oldMaxHp=hero.maxHp,oldMaxMp=hero.maxMp,oldMaxTp=hero.maxTp,oldAtk=hero.atk,oldDef=hero.def;
  hero.lv++;
  hero.next=hero.lv>=currentLevelCap()?0:8+hero.lv*5;

  const late=hero.lv>=15;
  const hpStep=late?8:6;
  const mpStep=late?3:2;
  const tpCharge=late?35:25;
  const atkStep=late?3:2;
  const defStep=late?2:1;

  hero.maxHp=Math.min(HERO_LIMITS.hp,hero.maxHp+hpStep);
  hero.maxMp=Math.min(HERO_LIMITS.mp,hero.maxMp+mpStep);
  hero.maxTp=tpCapForLevel(hero.lv);
  hero.atk=Math.min(HERO_LIMITS.atk,hero.atk+atkStep);
  hero.def=Math.min(HERO_LIMITS.def,hero.def+defStep);

  const hpGain=hero.maxHp-oldMaxHp,mpGain=hero.maxMp-oldMaxMp,tpCapGain=hero.maxTp-oldMaxTp;
  const atkGain=hero.atk-oldAtk,defGain=hero.def-oldDef;

  hero.hp=hero.maxHp;
  hero.mp=hero.maxMp;
  const tpBefore=hero.tp;
  hero.tp=clamp(hero.tp+tpCharge,0,hero.maxTp);
  const tpActual=hero.tp-tpBefore;

  if(hero.lv===2)learned.push('회복');
  if(hero.lv===3)learned.push('불꽃','시장 돌진');
  if(hero.lv===4)learned.push('번개');
  if(hero.lv===5)learned.push('회오리','진주성 일섬');
  if(hero.lv===6)learned.push('대회복','방어막');
  if(hero.lv===7)learned.push('별빛','1884 대행진');
  if(hero.lv===8)learned.push('진주폭풍');
  if(hero.lv===9)learned.push('황금장바구니 강타');

  return {learned,hpGain,mpGain,tpGain:tpActual,tpCapGain,atkGain,defGain}
 }

 function fantasyCoinDrop(e){
  let amount=0;
  if(e.boss){if(Math.random()<.62)amount=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*2)}
  else if(Math.random()<.27)amount=1+(Math.random()<.14?1:0);
  if(!amount)return 0;
  const coinBonus=amount*10;fantasyBonusCoins+=coinBonus;
  const fx=document.createElement('div');fx.className='fantasyCoinDropFx';fx.textContent=`🪙 +${coinBonus}`;battleFx.appendChild(fx);setTimeout(()=>fx.remove(),1300);
  tone('coin');buzz([12,6,22]);log(`${e.name}이(가) 동전을 떨어뜨렸다! 🪙 +${coinBonus}`);updateHud();return coinBonus
 }
 function win(){if(!battle)return;const e=battle.enemy;if(e.finalBoss&&e.phase<3){transformFinalBoss(e.phase+1);return}score+=e.score||300;log(`${e.name}을(를) 물리쳤다!  function runMagicCombo(id,totalDmg){
  const cfg=magicComboConfig(id);if(!cfg||!battle)return false;

  if(cfg.hits===1){
   battle.enemy.hp=Math.max(0,battle.enemy.hp-totalDmg);
   enemyHitFx(totalDmg,id);battleStatus();updateHud();return false
  }

  magicImpactFx(id);

  let hit=0,applied=0;
  const weightedTotal=Math.max(cfg.hits,Math.floor(totalDmg*cfg.totalScale));
  const next=()=>{
   if(!battle)return;
   hit++;
   const remain=weightedTotal-applied;
   let dmg;
   if(hit===cfg.hits)dmg=Math.max(1,remain);
   else{
    const hitsLeft=cfg.hits-hit+1;
    dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(remain/hitsLeft*(.84+Math.random()*.22)));
    dmg=Math.min(dmg,remain-(hitsLeft-1))
   }
   applied+=dmg;
   battle.enemy.hp=Math.max(0,battle.enemy.hp-dmg);
   magicChainHitFx(id,hit,cfg.hits,dmg);
   battleStatus();updateHud();
   log(hit===cfg.hits?`${cfg.name} · ${hit}연쇄 HIT! · 총 ${applied} 피해!`:`${cfg.name} · ${hit} / ${cfg.hits} 연쇄타격 · 누적 ${applied} 피해!`);

   if(hit<cfg.hits)setTimeout(next,cfg.interval);
   else{
    const delay=id==='wind'?480:id==='pearl'?420:360;
    if(battle.enemy.hp<=0)setTimeout(()=>{if(battle)win()},delay);
    else setTimeout(()=>{if(battle)enemyTurn()},delay)
   }
  };
  next();return true
 }

 function applyBossBattleVisual(e){
  battleView.classList.remove('finalBossPhase2View','finalBossPhase3View');
  enemyEl.className='fantasyEnemy';

  if(e.boss){
   const bk=bossKind(e);
   enemyEl.classList.add('bossArt','boss'+bk.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+bk.slice(1));

   if(e.finalBoss){
    enemyEl.classList.add(`finalPhase${e.phase}`);
    const tags=['','제1형태 · 흑우령','제2형태 · 폭주 흑우왕','최종형태 · 악령 흑우혼'];

    if(e.phase===2){
     battleView.classList.add('finalBossPhase2View');
     enemyEl.innerHTML=finalBossSvg(2)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[2]}</span>`
    }else if(e.phase===3){
     battleView.classList.add('finalBossPhase3View');
     enemyEl.innerHTML=finalBossSvg(3)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[3]}</span>`
    }else{
     enemyEl.innerHTML=bossBattleSvg(e)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[1]}</span>`
    }
   }else enemyEl.innerHTML=bossBattleSvg(e)
  }else enemyEl.textContent=e.icon;

  $('#fantasyEnemyName').textContent=e.name
 }
 function startBattle(enemy){
  const e={...enemy,def:(enemy.def!==undefined?enemy.def:(enemy.defn||0)),maxHp:enemy.hp};
  const isFinal=!!(e.boss&&zone===4&&e.name.includes('마왕 흑우령'));
  if(isFinal){e.finalBoss=true;e.phase=1;e.name='마왕 흑우령 · 제1형태'}
  battle={enemy:e,busy:false,barrier:false,finalBase:isFinal?{hp:e.maxHp,atk:e.atk,def:e.def}:null};
  hero.guard=false;closeDialog();controls.style.display='none';battleEl.classList.add('show');
  applyBossBattleVisual(e);battleHero.src=heroImg.src;
  startBGM(e.boss?'rpgBoss':'rpgBattle',1);
  log(isFinal?'마왕 흑우령이 첫 번째 모습으로 나타났다!':`${e.name}이(가) 나타났다!`);
  battleStatus();subEl.classList.remove('show')
 }

 function applyBossBattleVisual(e){
  battleView.classList.remove('finalBossPhase2View','finalBossPhase3View');
  enemyEl.className='fantasyEnemy';

  if(e.boss){
   const bk=bossKind(e);
   enemyEl.classList.add('bossArt','boss'+bk.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+bk.slice(1));

   if(e.finalBoss){
    enemyEl.classList.add(`finalPhase${e.phase}`);
    const tags=['','제1형태 · 흑우령','제2형태 · 폭주 흑우왕','최종형태 · 악령 흑우혼'];

    if(e.phase===2){
     battleView.classList.add('finalBossPhase2View');
     enemyEl.innerHTML=finalBossSvg(2)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[2]}</span>`
    }else if(e.phase===3){
     battleView.classList.add('finalBossPhase3View');
     enemyEl.innerHTML=finalBossSvg(3)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[3]}</span>`
    }else{
     enemyEl.innerHTML=bossBattleSvg(e)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[1]}</span>`
    }
   }else enemyEl.innerHTML=bossBattleSvg(e)
  }else enemyEl.textContent=e.icon;

  $('#fantasyEnemyName').textContent=e.name
 }
 function startBattle(enemy){
  const e={...enemy,def:(enemy.def!==undefined?enemy.def:(enemy.defn||0)),maxHp:enemy.hp};
  const isFinal=!!(e.boss&&zone===4&&e.name.includes('마왕 흑우령'));
  if(isFinal){e.finalBoss=true;e.phase=1;e.name='마왕 흑우령 · 제1형태'}
  battle={enemy:e,busy:false,barrier:false,finalBase:isFinal?{hp:e.maxHp,atk:e.atk,def:e.def}:null};
  hero.guard=false;closeDialog();controls.style.display='none';battleEl.classList.add('show');
  applyBossBattleVisual(e);battleHero.src=heroImg.src;
  startBGM(e.boss?'rpgBoss':'rpgBattle',1);
  log(isFinal?'마왕 흑우령이 첫 번째 모습으로 나타났다!':`${e.name}이(가) 나타났다!`);
  battleStatus();subEl.classList.remove('show')
 }

  if(!battle)return;
  setTimeout(()=>{
   if(!battle)return;

   const e=battle.enemy;
   const phase=e.finalBoss?(e.phase||1):1;

   /* 최종마왕도 한 턴에 실제 피해는 1회만 준다.
      형태가 올라갈수록 공격력/연출은 강해지지만 연속 피해로 행동권을 빼앗지 않는다. */
   let postMove='',nongaJudgment=false;
   if(e.postBoss==='nonga'){
    if(e.judgmentReady){
     nongaJudgment=true;e.judgmentReady=false
    }else{
     e.nongaTurn=(e.nongaTurn||0)+1;
     if(e.nongaTurn%4===0){
      e.judgmentReady=true;hero.guard=false;
      log('대천사논개가 날개를 펼쳤다! <천상심판> 준비 — 다음 공격을 방어하자!');
      battleStatus();updateHud();beep(880,.10,.035,'triangle',1320);buzz([20,8,34,8,48]);
      setTimeout(()=>{if(battle)battle.busy=false},360);return
     }
    }
   }
   let dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(e.atk-totalDef()*.55+Math.random()*4));
   if(e.postBoss==='darkGeneral'&&Math.random()<.30){dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*1.28));postMove='암흑영웅장군의 심연참'}
   if(nongaJudgment){dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*1.35));postMove='대천사논개의 천상심판'}
   if(hero.guard)dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*.45));
   if(battle.barrier){dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*.55));battle.barrier=false}

   let blocked=false;

   heroHitFx(dmg,blocked);
   hero.

 function applyBossBattleVisual(e){
  battleView.classList.remove('finalBossPhase2View','finalBossPhase3View');
  enemyEl.className='fantasyEnemy';

  if(e.boss){
   const bk=bossKind(e);
   enemyEl.classList.add('bossArt','boss'+bk.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+bk.slice(1));

   if(e.finalBoss){
    enemyEl.classList.add(`finalPhase${e.phase}`);
    const tags=['','제1형태 · 흑우령','제2형태 · 폭주 흑우왕','최종형태 · 악령 흑우혼'];

    if(e.phase===2){
     battleView.classList.add('finalBossPhase2View');
     enemyEl.innerHTML=finalBossSvg(2)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[2]}</span>`
    }else if(e.phase===3){
     battleView.classList.add('finalBossPhase3View');
     enemyEl.innerHTML=finalBossSvg(3)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[3]}</span>`
    }else{
     enemyEl.innerHTML=bossBattleSvg(e)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[1]}</span>`
    }
   }else enemyEl.innerHTML=bossBattleSvg(e)
  }else enemyEl.textContent=e.icon;

  $('#fantasyEnemyName').textContent=e.name
 }
 function startBattle(enemy){
  const e={...enemy,def:(enemy.def!==undefined?enemy.def:(enemy.defn||0)),maxHp:enemy.hp};
  const isFinal=!!(e.boss&&zone===4&&e.name.includes('마왕 흑우령'));
  if(isFinal){e.finalBoss=true;e.phase=1;e.name='마왕 흑우령 · 제1형태'}
  battle={enemy:e,busy:false,barrier:false,finalBase:isFinal?{hp:e.maxHp,atk:e.atk,def:e.def}:null};
  hero.guard=false;closeDialog();controls.style.display='none';battleEl.classList.add('show');
  applyBossBattleVisual(e);battleHero.src=heroImg.src;
  startBGM(e.boss?'rpgBoss':'rpgBattle',1);
  log(isFinal?'마왕 흑우령이 첫 번째 모습으로 나타났다!':`${e.name}이(가) 나타났다!`);
  battleStatus();subEl.classList.remove('show')
 }
 function closeSub(){subEl.classList.remove('show');subEl.innerHTML=''}
 function sub(kind){if(!battle||battle.busy)return;let html='';if(kind==='magic'){const a=spells();html=(a.length?a.map(x=>`<button data-spell="${x.id}" ${hero.mp<x.mp?'disabled':''}>${x.name} · MP ${x.mp}</button>`).join(''):'<button disabled>아직 익힌 마법이 없다.</button>')}else if(kind==='special'){const a=specials();html=(a.length?a.map(x=>`<button data-special="${x.id}" ${hero.tp<x.tp?'disabled':''}>${x.name} · TP ${x.tp}</button>`).join(''):'<button disabled>아직 익힌 필살기가 없다.</button>')}else{const a=[['포션',run.inventory.포션||0],['에테르',run.inventory.에테르||0],['성수',run.inventory.성수||0]];html=a.map(x=>`<button data-item="${x[0]}" ${x[1]<=0?'disabled':''}>${x[0]} ×${x[1]}</button>`).join('')}subEl.innerHTML=html+'<button class="cancel" data-cancel="1">취소</button>';subEl.classList.add('show')}

   let postMove='',nongaJudgment=false;
   if(e.postBoss==='nonga'){
    if(e.judgmentReady){
     nongaJudgment=true;e.judgmentReady=false
    }else{
     e.nongaTurn=(e.nongaTurn||0)+1;
     if(e.nongaTurn%4===0){
      e.judgmentReady=true;hero.guard=false;
      log('대천사논개가 날개를 펼쳤다! <천상심판> 준비 — 다음 공격을 방어하자!');
      battleStatus();updateHud();beep(880,.10,.035,'triangle',1320);buzz([20,8,34,8,48]);
      setTimeout(()=>{if(battle)battle.busy=false},360);return
     }
    }
   }
   let dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(e.atk-totalDef()*.55+Math.random()*4));
   if(e.postBoss==='darkGeneral'&&Math.random()<.30){dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*1.28));postMove='암흑영웅장군의 심연참'}
   if(nongaJudgment){dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*1.35));postMove='대천사논개의 천상심판'}
   if(hero.guard)dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*.45));
   if(battle.barrier){dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*.55));battle.barrier=false}

   let blocked=false;

   heroHitFx(dmg,blocked);
   hero.hp=Math.max(0,hero.hp-dmg);
   hero.tp=clamp(hero.tp+12,0,hero.maxTp);
   hero.guard=false;
   battleStatus();updateHud();

   if(blocked){
    log('황금장바구니방패가 공격을 막았다!')

 function applyBossBattleVisual(e){
  battleView.classList.remove('finalBossPhase2View','finalBossPhase3View');
  enemyEl.className='fantasyEnemy';

  if(e.boss){
   const bk=bossKind(e);
   enemyEl.classList.add('bossArt','boss'+bk.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+bk.slice(1));

   if(e.finalBoss){
    enemyEl.classList.add(`finalPhase${e.phase}`);
    const tags=['','제1형태 · 흑우령','제2형태 · 폭주 흑우왕','최종형태 · 악령 흑우혼'];

    if(e.phase===2){
     battleView.classList.add('finalBossPhase2View');
     enemyEl.innerHTML=finalBossSvg(2)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[2]}</span>`
    }else if(e.phase===3){
     battleView.classList.add('finalBossPhase3View');
     enemyEl.innerHTML=finalBossSvg(3)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[3]}</span>`
    }else{
     enemyEl.innerHTML=bossBattleSvg(e)+`<span class="finalBossPhaseTag">${tags[1]}</span>`
    }
   }else enemyEl.innerHTML=bossBattleSvg(e)
  }else enemyEl.textContent=e.icon;

  $('#fantasyEnemyName').textContent=e.name
 }
 function startBattle(enemy){
  const e={...enemy,def:(enemy.def!==undefined?enemy.def:(enemy.defn||0)),maxHp:enemy.hp};
  const isFinal=!!(e.boss&&zone===4&&e.name.includes('마왕 흑우령'));
  if(isFinal){e.finalBoss=true;e.phase=1;e.name='마왕 흑우령 · 제1형태'}
  battle={enemy:e,busy:false,barrier:false,finalBase:isFinal?{hp:e.maxHp,atk:e.atk,def:e.def}:null};
  hero.guard=false;closeDialog();controls.style.display='none';battleEl.classList.add('show');
  applyBossBattleVisual(e);battleHero.src=heroImg.src;
  startBGM(e.boss?'rpgBoss':'rpgBattle',1);
  log(isFinal?'마왕 흑우령이 첫 번째 모습으로 나타났다!':`${e.name}이(가) 나타났다!`);
  battleStatus();subEl.classList.remove('show')
 }

      battleStatus();updateHud();beep(880,.10,.035,'triangle',1320);buzz([20,8,34,8,48]);

     }
    }

 function enemyTurn(){
  if(!battle)return;
  setTimeout(()=>{
   if(!battle)return;

   const e=battle.enemy;
   const phase=e.finalBoss?(e.phase||1):1;

   /* 최종마왕도 한 턴에 실제 피해는 1회만 준다.
      형태가 올라갈수록 공격력/연출은 강해지지만 연속 피해로 행동권을 빼앗지 않는다. */
   let postMove='',nongaJudgment=false;
   if(e.postBoss==='nonga'){
    if(e.judgmentReady){
     nongaJudgment=true;e.judgmentReady=false
    }else{
     e.nongaTurn=(e.nongaTurn||0)+1;
     if(e.nongaTurn%4===0){
      e.judgmentReady=true;hero.guard=false;
      log('대천사논개가 날개를 펼쳤다! <천상심판> 준비 — 다음 공격을 방어하자!');
      battleStatus();updateHud();beep(880,.10,.035,'triangle',1320);buzz([20,8,34,8,48]);
      setTimeout(()=>{if(battle)battle.busy=false},360);return
     }
    }
   }
   let dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(e.atk-totalDef()*.55+Math.random()*4));
   if(e.postBoss==='darkGeneral'&&Math.random()<.30){dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*1.28));postMove='암흑영웅장군의 심연참'}
   if(nongaJudgment){dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*1.35));postMove='대천사논개의 천상심판'}
   if(hero.guard)dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*.45));
   if(battle.barrier){dmg=Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg*.55));battle.barrier=false}

   let blocked=false;

   heroHitFx(dmg,blocked);
   hero.hp=Math.max(0,hero.hp-dmg);
   hero.tp=clamp(hero.tp+12,0,hero.maxTp);
   hero.guard=false;
   battleStatus();updateHud();

   if(blocked){
    log('황금장바구니방패가 공격을 막았다!')
   }else if(postMove){
    log(`${postMove}! ${dmg} 피해!`);if(e.postBoss==='nonga')buzz([24,8,38,8,56]);else bombBuzz()
   }else if(e.finalBoss&&phase===2){
    log(`폭주 흑우왕의 중압 강타! ${dmg} 피해!`);
    buzz([18,7,30])
   }else if(e.finalBoss&&phase===3){
    log(`악령 흑우혼의 영혼 침식! ${dmg} 피해!`);
    bombBuzz()
   }else{
    log(`${e.name}의 공격! ${dmg} 피해!`)
   }

   if(hero.hp<=0){loseBattle();return}
   setTimeout(()=>{if(battle)battle.busy=false},320)
  },680)

 function act(kind,id){
  if(!battle||battle.busy)return;
  closeSub();battle.busy=true;
  let dmg=0,text='',fx='none';

  if(kind==='attack'){
   const criticalChance=Math.min(.13,.075+hero.lv*.006);
   const critical=Math.random()<criticalChance;
   if(critical){
    dmg=phys(2.6)+hero.lv*2;
    hero.tp=clamp(hero.tp+18,0,hero.maxTp);
    text=`회심의 일격!! ${dmg} 피해!`;fx='critical'
   }else{
    dmg=phys(1);hero.tp=clamp(hero.tp+10,0,hero.maxTp);
    text=`공격! ${dmg} 피해!`;fx='slash'
   }
  }else if(kind==='guard'){
   hero.guard=true;hero.tp=clamp(hero.tp+8,0,hero.maxTp);log('방어 자세를 취했다.');battleStatus();buzz(8);return enemyTurn()
  }else if(kind==='spell'){
   const sp=spells().find(x=>x.id===id);
   if(!sp||hero.mp<sp.mp){battle.busy=false;return}
   hero.mp-=sp.mp;
   if(id==='heal'){const h=12+hero.lv*2;hero.hp=Math.min(hero.maxHp,hero.hp+h);text=`회복! HP ${h} 회복.`;fx='heal'}
   else if(id==='greaterHeal'){const h=28+hero.lv*3;hero.hp=Math.min(hero.maxHp,hero.hp+h);text=`대회복! HP ${h} 회복.`;fx='greaterHeal'}
   else if(id==='barrier'){battle.barrier=true;text='방어막! 다음 공격의 피해를 크게 줄인다.';fx='barrier'}
   else{dmg=spellDmg(id);text=`${sp.name}!${battle.enemy.weak===id?' 약점을 찔렀다!':''}`;fx=id}
  }else if(kind==='special'){
   const sp=specials().find(x=>x.id===id);
   if(!sp||hero.tp<sp.tp){battle.busy=false;return}
   hero.tp-=sp.tp;updateHud();
   runSpecialCombo(id);return
  }else if(kind==='item'){
   if(id==='포션'&&(run.inventory.포션||0)>0){run.inventory.포션--;const before=hero.hp;hero.hp=hero.maxHp;const healed=Math.max(0,hero.hp-before);text=`포션! HP 완전회복! +${healed}`;fx='greaterHeal'}
   else if(id==='에테르'&&(run.inventory.에테르||0)>0){run.inventory.에테르--;const before=hero.mp;hero.mp=hero.maxMp;const restored=Math.max(0,hero.mp-before);text=`에테르! MP 완전회복! +${restored}`;fx='heal'}

   if(id==='heal'){const h=12+hero.lv*2;hero.hp=Math.min(hero.maxHp,hero.hp+h);text=`회복! HP ${h} 회복.`;fx='heal'}
   else if(id==='greaterHeal'){const h=28+hero.lv*3;hero.hp=Math.min(hero.maxHp,hero.hp+h);text=`대회복! HP ${h} 회복.`;fx='greaterHeal'}
   else if(id==='barrier'){battle.barrier=true;text='방어막! 다음 공격의 피해를 크게 줄인다.';fx='barrier'}
   else{dmg=spellDmg(id);text=`${sp.name}!${battle.enemy.weak===id?' 약점을 찔렀다!':''}`;fx=id}
  }else if(kind==='special'){
   const sp=specials().find(x=>x.id===id);
   if(!sp||hero.tp<sp.tp){battle.busy=false;return}
   hero.tp-=sp.tp;updateHud();
   runSpecialCombo(id);return
  }else if(kind==='item'){
   if(id==='포션'&&(run.inventory.포션||0)>0){run.inventory.포션--;const before=hero.hp;hero.hp=hero.maxHp;const healed=Math.max(0,hero.hp-before);text=`포션! HP 완전회복! +${healed}`;fx='greaterHeal'}
   else if(id==='에테르'&&(run.inventory.에테르||0)>0){run.inventory.에테르--;const before=hero.mp;hero.mp=hero.maxMp;const restored=Math.max(0,hero.mp-before);text=`에테르! MP 완전회복! +${restored}`;fx='heal'}
   else if(id==='성수'&&(run.inventory.성수||0)>0){run.inventory.성수--;dmg=22+hero.lv*3;text=`성수! ${dmg} 빛 피해!`;fx='star'}
   else{battle.busy=false;return}
  }

  if(dmg>0){
   if(['fire','bolt','wind','star','pearl'].includes(fx)){
    log(text);
    const chained=runMagicCombo(fx,dmg);
    if(chained)return
   }else{
    battle.enemy.hp=Math.max(0,battle.enemy.hp-dmg);
    if(fx==='critical')criticalHitFx(dmg);else enemyHitFx(dmg,fx)
   }
  }else if(['heal','greaterHeal','barrier'].includes(fx))healFx(fx);

  log(text);if(!['fire','bolt','wind','star','pearl','heal','greaterHeal','barrier'].includes(fx))tone(dmg>0?'good':'coin');battleStatus();updateHud();
  if(battle.enemy.hp<=0){setTimeout(win,fx==='critical'?900:720);return}
  enemyTurn()
 }
 function finalTransformFanfare(phase){
  const seq=phase===2?[[110,0],[220,90],[330,180],[440,290],[660,430]]:[[82,0],[165,80],[330,170],[494,270],[740,390],[988,540]];
  seq.forEach((n,i)=>setTimeout(()=>beep(n[0],i===seq.length-1?.22:.10,i===seq.length-1?.060:.038,i%2?'square':'sawtooth',n[0]*1.12),n[1]));
  bombBuzz();setTimeout(()=>bombBuzz(),phase===3?220:310);if(phase===3)setTimeout(()=>buzz([55,15,85]),520)
 }

 function finalTransformFanfare(phase){
  const seq=phase===2?[[110,0],[220,90],[330,180],[440,290],[660,430]]:[[82,0],[165,80],[330,170],[494,270],[740,390],[988,540]];
  seq.forEach((n,i)=>setTimeout(()=>beep(n[0],i===seq.length-1?.22:.10,i===seq.length-1?.060:.038,i%2?'square':'sawtooth',n[0]*1.12),n[1]));

 }
 function transformFinalBoss(nextPhase){
  if(!battle||!battle.enemy.finalBoss||nextPhase>3)return;
  battle.busy=true;closeSub();stopBGM();

  const e=battle.enemy,b=battle.finalBase;
  enemyEl.classList.add('bossMorphOut');

  e.phase=nextPhase;
  if(nextPhase===2){
   e.name='마왕 흑우령 · 제2형태';
   e.maxHp=Math.ceil(b.hp*1.55);e.hp=e.maxHp;
   e.atk=Math.ceil(b.atk*1.32)+2;e.def=b.def+4;e.weak='star'
  }else{
   e.name='마왕 흑우령 · 최종형태';
   e.maxHp=Math.ceil(b.hp*2.05);e.hp=e.maxHp;
   e.atk=Math.ceil(b.atk*1.62)+4;e.def=b.def+7;e.weak='star'
  }

  const fx=document.createElement('div');
  fx.className='finalTransformFx'+(nextPhase===3?' phase3':'');
  fx.innerHTML=`<div class="transformText">${nextPhase===2?'육체 진화! · 폭주 흑우왕':'육체 붕괴! · 악령 흑우혼'}</div><i class="shock"></i><i class="shock s2"></i><i class="shock s3"></i>`;
  battleFx.appendChild(fx);setTimeout(()=>fx.remove(),1850);

  clearFxClass(battleView,'battleShakeHeavy');
  finalTransformFanfare(nextPhase);

  /* 기존 모습이 붕괴한 뒤 새 SVG 본체를 교체해 실제 변신이 눈에 보이게 함 */
  setTimeout(()=>{
   if(!battle)return;
   flashBattle('white');
   applyBossBattleVisual(e);
   battleStatus();
   if(nextPhase===2){
    log('흑우령의 육체가 거대하게 진화했다! 폭주 흑우왕!');
    bombBuzz()
   }else{
    log('육체가 무너지고 악령의 영혼이 해방됐다! 최종형태 악령 흑우혼!');
    bombBuzz();setTimeout(()=>buzz([45,10,70,12,100]),180)
   }
  },390);

  setTimeout(()=>{
   if(!battle)return;
   startBGM(nextPhase===2?'rpgFinal2':'rpgFinal3',1);
   battle.busy=false
  },1650)
 }

 function fantasyCoinDrop(e){
  let amount=0;
  if(e.boss){if(Math.random()<.62)amount=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*2)}
  else if(Math.random()<.27)amount=1+(Math.random()<.14?1:0);
  if(!amount)return 0;
  const coinBonus=amount*10;fantasyBonusCoins+=coinBonus;
  const fx=document.createElement('div');fx.className='fantasyCoinDropFx';fx.textContent=`🪙 +${coinBonus}`;battleFx.appendChild(fx);setTimeout(()=>fx.remove(),1300);
  tone('coin');buzz([12,6,22]);log(`${e.name}이(가) 동전을 떨어뜨렸다! 🪙 +${coinBonus}`);updateHud();return coinBonus

   if(boss.hp<=0)finishBoss()
  }

  updateHud();

  ctx.save();
  if(screenShake>0)ctx.translate((Math.random()-.5)*screenShake,(Math.random()-.5)*screenShake);
  drawBackground(st,dt);

  // 플레이어 탄
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  for(const o of shots){
   ctx.save();
   ctx.globalAlpha=o.clone?.72:1;
   ctx.shadowBlur=o.clone?8:13;
   ctx.shadowColor=group==='oso'?'#ffd35b':'#7ceaff';
   if(isKf21){

   }else{

    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x,o.y,o.clone?4.5:6.5,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke()
   }
   ctx.restore()
  }

  }

   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#fff9';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()
  });

 function firePlayer(ts){

  alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();
  superBtn.onclick=null;stopBGM()
 }
}
